sentences.text: The UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 state that the penal-charges instructions apply to fresh loans availed from April 1, 2024 onwards, and they do not state a move date for existing loan accounts.

The earlier penal-charges instruction for existing loans said the switchover to the new penal charges regime had to be ensured on the next review or renewal date or six months from the effective date of those instructions, whichever was earlier.
That earlier instruction was later superseded and withdrawn.
The current evidence therefore does not support a specific move date for existing loan accounts under the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025.

missing.slot: specific move date for existing loan accounts under the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025
